infoItem.aboutP1_1: spotshop is a B2B marketplace for companies, operated by Octagram JSC, Tashkent.
infoItem.aboutP1_2: You will find electronics, home appliances, clothing, shoes, home, beauty, sports and kids products from verified sellers all over Uzbekistan.
infoItem.aboutP2_1: Choose a product, add it to the cart and place an order. A spotshop courier will bring it — or collect it at a pick-up point.
infoItem.aboutP2_2: Companies pay for orders from an on-site balance, topped up by transfer from their settlement account, or with a corporate card. The amount is reserved and goes to the seller's settlement account once the order is confirmed.
infoItem.aboutP3_1: Every seller passes a document check, and buyer ratings and reviews are shown on the product page.
infoItem.aboutP3_2: If a product does not fit or does not match its description, request a return within 10 days in “My orders”.
infoItem.blogP1_1: Reviews of new categories, purchasing tips for companies, platform changes and terms for sellers.
infoItem.blogH2: Our first articles are on the way
infoItem.blogP2_1: This section is being filled. Follow spotshop on Telegram and Instagram for announcements of deals and new articles.
infoItem.partnersP1_1: Stores and brands, manufacturers, distributors and delivery services that want to sell across Uzbekistan.
infoItem.partnersP2_1: A storefront with photos and specifications, company orders from the catalog and search, statistics and review management.
infoItem.partnersP2_2: Commission depends on the product category, and payouts go to your bank account. Submit an application and we will send the rates.
infoItem.partnersP3_1: Fill in the form, send your registration documents and wait for verification — it usually takes one business day.
infoItem.postAdH1: What you need to start selling
infoItem.postAdP1_1: A registered sole proprietorship or company, a bank account for payouts, and products with photos, prices and descriptions.
infoItem.postAdP1_2: Electronics and kids' products need certificates of conformity; branded items need proof of authenticity.
infoItem.postAdP2_1: Seller verification takes up to one business day, product cards up to 24 hours. If something is missing, we will tell you what to add.
infoItem.postAdP3_1: Counterfeits and replicas passed off as originals, products without mandatory certificates, medicines, weapons and anything prohibited by the law of Uzbekistan.
infoItem.servicesP1_1: Courier delivery and pick-up points across Uzbekistan, a company balance topped up by invoice, and corporate card payment.
infoItem.servicesP2_1: Delivery options and prices are shown at checkout. The money is reserved and goes to the seller once the order is confirmed.
infoItem.servicesP2_2: After checkout, the courier or pick-up point will notify you when the order is ready.
infoItem.helpP1_1: The order status is shown in the “My orders” section, along with the number, date, contents and total.
infoItem.helpP1_2: You can cancel an order until it is handed over for delivery — the button appears on the order card.
infoItem.helpP2_1: We deliver with our own spotshop couriers and to spotshop pick-up points. The delivery date is shown on the product card.
infoItem.helpP2_2: The courier contacts you before setting off to confirm the time.
infoItem.helpP3_1: Pay from company balance or with a corporate card.
infoItem.helpP3_2: You can return a product within 10 days in “My orders”. The money is refunded the same way you paid.
infoItem.helpP4_1: Write to us through the form on the “Contact us” page — we reply within one business day.
infoItem.deliveryP1_1: Orders are delivered by spotshop's own couriers: from one day in Tashkent, 2–5 days to the regions. The courier will call before arriving.
infoItem.deliveryP2_1: Delivery to a spotshop pick-up point is free. Orders are kept for 7 days; check the product and its contents when you collect it.
infoItem.deliveryP3_1: Write to us via “Contact us” with your order number — we will contact the delivery service and get back to you.
infoItem.chatP1_1: Support chat is available from 9:00 to 21:00 Tashkent time.
infoItem.chatP2_1: Your order number and a short description of the issue — that way we reply faster.
infoItem.chatP3_1: Leave a message via the “Contact us” form: we will reply at the start of the next business day.
infoItem.cookieP1_1: Cookies store your chosen language, cart contents and sign-in — without them this data would be lost when moving between pages.
infoItem.cookieP2_1: Technical — sign-in, cart, language. Analytical — anonymized visit statistics.
infoItem.cookieP3_1: You can disable cookies in your browser settings. After that the cart and sign-in will not work.
infoItem.documentsP1_1: The platform’s public documents and offers.
infoItem.documentsP2_1: The documents will appear here once reviewed by a lawyer. For now you can request a copy via the “Contact us” form.
infoItem.termsP1_1: The agreement sets out the terms under which buyers and sellers use the spotshop marketplace (operated by Octagram JSC).
infoItem.termsP2_1: The full text is being reviewed by a lawyer and will be published here. Until then the terms shown on product cards and at checkout apply.
infoItem.privacyP1_1: An employee's name and phone, company details, delivery address and order history. We need them to place and deliver an order.
infoItem.privacyP2_1: The full text of the policy is being reviewed by a lawyer and will be published here.
infoItem.rulesP1_1: Your own photos on a light background, an accurate title with brand and model, an honest description, and an up-to-date price and stock.
infoItem.rulesP2_1: Other people's photos, counterfeits passed off as originals, an inflated “old” price to fake a discount, hidden defects.
infoItem.rulesP3_1: The card is removed from sale and the seller is told why. Repeated violations lead to the store being blocked.
infoItem.termsConditionsP1_1: Terms of use for the spotshop marketplace.
infoItem.termsConditionsP2_1: The full text is being reviewed by a lawyer and will be published here.
infoItem.contactP1_1: Contact support — we reply within one business day.
infoItem.contactP1_2: If your question is about an order, include its number: that way we reply faster.
infoItem.complaintP1_1: Describe the problem with the order or seller — we will review your request.
infoItem.complaintP1_2: Include the order number, the date and exactly what went wrong.
infoItem.rulesP2_2: Medicines, weapons, tobacco and other goods whose online sale is prohibited by the law of Uzbekistan.
infoItem.rulesP4_1: If a card was removed and you disagree, write via “File a complaint”: give the product SKU and attach documents.

faq.intro: Answers to common questions from buying companies and sellers.
faq.empty: Nothing found. Try another word or write to us.

payHow.q: How does a company pay for an order
payHow.a: From the company balance on the site or with a corporate card. You choose the method at checkout.

payTopUp.q: How do I top up the balance
payTopUp.a: In "Company balance", enter the amount and create an invoice. Transfer the money from the company settlement account using the invoice details. It appears on the balance once received.

payPersonal.q: Can I pay with a personal card or in installments
payPersonal.a: No. spotshop works with companies only: we accept the company balance and corporate cards.

payMoney.q: When does the seller get the money
payMoney.a: The amount is reserved at checkout. Once the order is confirmed it goes to the seller settlement account. If the order is rejected or cancelled it returns the same way.

ordStatus.q: Where can I see the order status
ordStatus.a: In "My orders", along with the order number, date, items and amount.

ordCancel.a: Yes, until it is handed over for delivery. The cancel button appears on the order card.

ordOriginal.q: How do I know a product is original
ordOriginal.a: Sellers of branded goods confirm authenticity with documents. If in doubt, write to support.

delWho.a: spotshop's own couriers. You can also choose a spotshop pickup point, which is free.

delTime.a: From one day in Tashkent, 2-5 days to the regions. The date and cost are shown at checkout.

delPickup.q: How long is an order kept at a pickup point
delPickup.a: 7 days. Check the goods and the set when you collect them.

retHow.q: How do I return a product
retHow.a: Request a return in "My orders" within 10 days. The product must keep its condition and packaging.

retMoney.a: Back the way the order was paid: to the company balance or the corporate card.

selStart.a: You need a registered sole proprietor or company, a settlement account for payouts, and products with photos, prices and descriptions. Fill in the form and send the documents.

selCheck.a: Seller verification takes up to one business day, a product card up to 24 hours.

selFee.a: It depends on the product category. Send a request and we will share the rates.
